verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents multi-currency settlement (24+ currencies), FX conversion, and smart routing that prefers domestic rails per currency/country for payouts, implying some country/currency coverage — but there is no single documented coverage map listing supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, or per-country settlement details that a founder could check without piecing together separate guides. Missing for 10: an explicit country-by-country or payment-method coverage matrix, list of supported local payment methods (e.g., iDEAL, SEPA, cards) per market, and consolidated onboarding-country documentation.
